profile.description: I create modern web applications, AI-powered solutions, and scalable software that help businesses grow, automate, and achieve exceptional results.
biography: Hi, I’m Aliza Zahid, a passionate Software Developer and Tech Entrepreneur. I specialize in building modern web applications, AI-powered solutions, and scalable software that help businesses grow and stand out.
With a strong foundation in full stack development and a deep interest in emerging technologies, I love transforming complex problems into simple, beautiful, and impactful digital experiences.
profile.positioning: Available worldwide for product builds, technical leadership, and AI-assisted software delivery.
profile.imageAlt: Aliza Zahid, Software Developer and founder of AlizaDev

experience.detail: Leading web, mobile, and AI product delivery for clients across software, commerce, and services.
Building high-performance interfaces and component systems for production web products.
Designing and shipping custom websites, dashboards, and AI-assisted software for international clients.
Built and shipped software features, interfaces, and client-facing product work before joining Webtrixsol.
Contributed to product development and frontend delivery before the FABTECHSOL and Webtrixsol roles.

faqs.question: What kind of products do you build?
faqs.answer: Web platforms, mobile apps, dashboards, AI-assisted software, and custom business systems — from first concept to launch.

faqs.question: How do projects usually start?
faqs.answer: A short discovery call, then a scoped plan covering architecture, interface, timeline, and delivery milestones.

faqs.question: Do you work with clients outside Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Yes. I am based in Sialkot and available worldwide for remote product work and technical leadership.

faqs.question: Can you take over an existing codebase?
faqs.answer: Yes. I regularly improve, redesign, and extend products that are already in production.

faqs.question: Is there a contact form?
faqs.answer: Not in the current design. Reach out directly by WhatsApp, phone, or email and we can start from there.
